metadata.title: Conditional AQUAL Closures, Formal Verification Boundaries, and a Reproducible SPARC Benchmark: A Technical Assessment
metadata.description: We present a rigorous technical assessment of the weak-field phenomenology arising from modified gravity formulations in the AQUAL family. Variational reduction, horizon thermodynamic scaling, 175-galaxy SPARC database empirical benchmarking, and Lean 4 formal machine-checked proof bounds are systematically documented under the Sovereign Epistemic Covenant.
